family_name: Autex Willie Weston / Emma Hayes Cube

spec.description:
Autex Willie Weston / Emma Hayes Cube combines high-performance Cube acoustic
panels with curated digital artwork from Australian First Nations artists
(Willie Weston) and New Zealand landscape designs (Emma Hayes). Manufactured
from 100% polyester fibre, the semi-rigid 12mm or 24mm Cube panels are digitally
printed using safe, water-based, UV-cured ink that does not compromise sound
absorption. Delivering an NRC of 0.45 to 0.70 (and up to 0.80 with an air gap),
this collection unites cultural storytelling and tranquil natural motifs with
certified Group 1 fire safety.

install:
Confirm substrate is plumb, flat, clean,
dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise printed panels in the installation environment
for at least 24 hours

Inspect panel pattern repeat and ensure sequence
alignment across adjacent panels

Handle panels with clean hands or white
gloves to prevent marks on the printed artwork

For adhesive direct fix, apply
recommended high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across panel backing
Alternatively, mount using Autex SpinFix clips or Peel and Stick backing

Butt panel edges tightly together and apply firm, uniform roller pressure
across the entire face

Trim perimeter panels carefully from the face using a
straight edge and sharp utility knife on the offcut side
selection_checklist:
Select curated design from Willie Weston (First
Nations art) or Emma Hayes (NZ landscapes)

Select thickness (12mm for
NRC 0.45-0.70 or 24mm for NRC 0.70-0.80)

Verify pattern repeat and sequential numbering
for multi-panel wall murals

Specify mounting system (adhesive direct-fix,
SpinFix, or Peel and Stick)
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct
exposure to running water

Printed decorative surface can be scuffed by heavy
mechanical abrasion; install in low-to-medium contact zones

Panel layout must
follow manufacturer pattern guide to maintain artwork alignment

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Willie Weston / Emma Hayes Cube
combines 12mm or 24mm semi-rigid Cube polyester acoustic panels with
high-resolution digital UV prints of Australian First Nations art (Willie
Weston) and New Zealand landscape designs (Emma Hayes). Delivering sound
absorption from NRC 0.45 to 0.70 (and up to 0.80 with an air gap), the panels
use safe water-based inks that do not reduce acoustic efficiency. Certified
Group 1 fire rated under AS ISO 9705, carbon neutral, and containing over 80%
recycled PET, this collection brings cultural storytelling and sound control to
commercial, educational, and civic interiors.
